cards.name: HDR Toning
cards.summary: Tone-maps the whole image through Photoshop's 32-bit HDR toning step, run by the bundled Required/HDRToning.jsx: it flattens the document (after asking), takes an 8 or 16-bit image up to 32 bpc and back down to its own depth through the HDR Toning dialog (a 32-bit document goes down to 16 and back up, so it stays 32-bit). Highlights are compressed, shadows opened and local edge contrast and detail pushed, giving the punchy, gritty 'HDR photo' look, with halo glow at strong settings. The dialog's controls were not harvested.
use_for: faux-HDR / gritty detail grade on a single flat exposure (architecture, cars, landscapes)
tone-mapping a 32-bit File/Automate/Merge to HDR Pro result in place (it stays 32-bit; Image/Mode/16 Bits/Channel is the step that converts it down)
punchy poster or album-art look with exaggerated local contrast
avoid: layered files: the script flattens the document (it asks first); work on a duplicate, or use Filter/Camera Raw Filter on a smart object for an editable version
faces and skin: halos and grit show fast; Image/Adjustments/Shadows/Highlights or Camera Raw is gentler
CMYK or Lab documents: the script only works in RGB or Grayscale and offers to convert

unattended scripts: there is no Action Manager event (harvest error); the menu script can raise confirm() prompts (flatten, convert to RGB) and always opens the HDR Toning dialog. The only no-dialog route is a helper in the installed StackSupport.jsx (see scripting), not run-tested
pairs_with: File/Automate/Merge to HDR Pro (its 32-bit result, tone-mapped in place)
Image/Adjustments/Shadows/Highlights (gentler shadow lift)
Filter/Camera Raw Filter (non-destructive alternative)
Presets/HDR Toning (16 factory .hdt presets: Photorealistic, Surrealistic, Monochromatic, City Twilight ...)
cards.scripting: No Action Manager event (harvest: HDR Toning is implemented by Required/HDRToning.jsx). With the dialog: $.evalFile(new File(app.path + '/Required/HDRToning.jsx'));  // asks before flattening / converting to RGB, converts to 32 bpc, opens the HDR Toning dialog. Without the dialog (installed Presets/Scripts/Stack Scripts Only/StackSupport.jsx convertFromHDRNoDialog; not run-tested, value ranges not harvested), on a flat RGB document already at 32 bpc: var t = new ActionDescriptor(); t.putInteger(stringIDToTypeID('version'), 4); t.putEnumerated(charIDToTypeID('Mthd'), stringIDToTypeID('hdrToningMethodType'), stringIDToTypeID('hdrtype4')); /* Local Adaptation: the helper also copies the doubles radius, threshold, saturation, vibrance, detail, shallow, highlights, contrast, brightness, the boolean smooth and a classFXShapeCurve toning curve; hdrtype1 = Highlight Compression, hdrtype2 = Exposure and Gamma (exposure, gamma), hdrtype3 = Equalize Histogram */ var d = new ActionDescriptor(); d.putInteger(charIDToTypeID('Dpth'), 8); d.putObject(charIDToTypeID('With'), stringIDToTypeID('hdrOptions'), t); executeAction(charIDToTypeID('CnvM'), d, DialogModes.NO);  The menu's command id -485 is negative, which the ps_menu harvest records as assigned per session (script entries), so it is not a stable performMenuCommand target.
cards.non_destructive: no: destructive (harvest) and it flattens the document; no adjustment-layer or smart-filter form
cards.cost: heavy: flatten + 32-bit conversion + tone-mapping pass, slow on large files

review.changes: use_for / summary: a 32-bit document is tone-mapped in place and stays 32-bit (HDRToning.jsx converts it to 16 and back), not converted down to 16 or 8 bit; scripting: dropped performMenuCommand -485 (ps_menu harvest: negative ids are assigned per session); added the no-dialog convertMode + hdrOptions route found in the installed StackSupport.jsx (not run-tested), so 'values cannot be set headless' in avoid is corrected; pairs_with: the 16 harvested factory HDR Toning .hdt presets

verified.note: Untested: no scripted route (gallery/ps_adjustment/failed.json: the harvest has no Action Manager event; HDR Toning runs through Required/HDRToning.jsx and its dialog), so there is no frame: a harness limit, not a fault of the effect.

second_opinion.note: No frame on disk and the id is listed in not_rendered.json / failed.json; the reason given matches the card status and the harvest.

cards.name: Hue/Saturation
cards.summary: Shifts hue, saturation and lightness for the whole image (Master) or for one colour family (Reds, Yellows, Greens, Cyans, Blues, Magentas); Colorize instead tints the whole image one hue for a monotone or sepia look. From Image > Adjustments it rewrites the pixels.
use_for: recolouring a product or garment by shifting one colour family
sepia / single-colour toning with Colorize for a vintage poster or thumbnail
pulling down an over-saturated colour or boosting a dull background
desaturating every colour family but one for a selective-colour look
avoid: recolouring one object whose colour also appears elsewhere: Hue/Saturation hits every pixel in the range; mask a Layer/New Adjustment Layer/Hue/Saturation or use Image/Adjustments/Replace Color
big hue shifts on gradients or skin: banding and odd edges
editable work: this menu version is destructive, use Layer/New Adjustment Layer/Hue/Saturation

params.name: Colorize
params.does: On: replaces all colour with a single hue set by the Adjustment values while keeping the tones, for a monotone / sepia look
params.typical: off for corrections, on for tints (default off)

params.name: Adjustment
params.does: the actual Hue / Saturation / Lightness values, for Master or a colour family; declared as an object (/hueSatAdjustment) whose member keys the harvest did not read
params.typical: hue +/-10 to 40 for shifts, saturation all the way down to strip colour

params.name: Using
params.does: loads a saved Hue/Saturation preset file (.ahu, e.g. Presets/Hue and Saturation/Sepia.ahu) instead of inline values
params.typical: a factory preset such as Sepia, Cyanotype or Strong Saturation

params.name: Preset Kind
params.does: records where the settings came from (Default, Factory Preset, User Preset, Custom)
params.typical: presetKindCustom when you pass your own values

pairs_with: a selection or layer mask to limit the shift
Layer/New Adjustment Layer/Hue/Saturation (same control, editable)
Image/Adjustments/Replace Color (choose the colour by sampling)
cards.scripting: var d = new ActionDescriptor(); d.putEnumerated(stringIDToTypeID('presetKind'), stringIDToTypeID('presetKindType'), stringIDToTypeID('presetKindCustom')); d.putBoolean(stringIDToTypeID('colorize'), true); /* values: the 'adjustment' key (declared /hueSatAdjustment, member keys not harvested; record one with ScriptingListener); or, instead of values, a factory preset: d.putPath(stringIDToTypeID('using'), new File(app.path + '/Presets/Hue and Saturation/Sepia.ahu')) (not run-tested) */ executeAction(stringIDToTypeID('hueSaturation'), d, DialogModes.NO);
cards.non_destructive: no: Image > Adjustments rewrites the pixels (harvest: destructive); the editable form is Layer/New Adjustment Layer/Hue/Saturation
cards.demo_note: Colorize alone: the Hue / Saturation / Lightness amounts sit in the Adjustment value, which the harvest did not break down, so the plate shows Photoshop's stored colorize amounts (a one-hue tint, or plain grey if that saturation is 0); untested.

review.changes: Adjustment described as the harvested object type (/hueSatAdjustment), not an ActionList the harvest never showed; demo_settings: added Preset Kind presetKindCustom to match the scripting call; gallery-limit note moved from avoid to demo_note

verified.note: Same red-brown Colorize monotone as the adjustment layer at the same values.

cards.name: Invert
cards.summary: Turns the image into its negative: every channel value is flipped to its opposite, so light becomes dark and each colour becomes its complement (red to cyan, blue to yellow). It has no settings.
use_for: photo-negative / x-ray look for a poster or album cover
flipping a mask, channel or black-on-white line art to white-on-black
a quick dark version of a scanned logo or sketch
avoid: inverting brightness but keeping the hues: use an Invert adjustment layer set to Luminosity blend mode
CMYK documents: each ink channel, black included, is inverted, which differs from an RGB negative; invert in RGB
editable work: use Layer/New Adjustment Layer/Invert
pairs_with: Luminosity blend mode (invert tones, keep hues)
Image/Adjustments/Gradient Map (recolour the negative)
layer masks (Ctrl+I on a mask flips what shows)
cards.non_destructive: no: destructive (harvest); the editable form is Layer/New Adjustment Layer/Invert

verified.note: Full negative of the plate, ramp reversed, blocks to their complements.

cards.name: Levels
cards.summary: Sets the black point, white point and midtone gamma of the composite or of each colour channel, plus output black / white, against a histogram: stretching the range adds contrast, moving channel points removes a cast. Its Auto flags are Photoshop's automatic corrections: the ps_menu harvest ran Image/Auto Tone (auto), Image/Auto Contrast (autoContrast) and Image/Auto Color (autoBlackWhite + autoNeutrals) live as this levels event.
use_for: fixing flat, low-contrast or washed-out photos before they go into a layout
clean black and white points on scanned art, sketches or documents
removing a colour cast channel by channel
lifted output blacks for a faded film look
avoid: shaping specific tones (S-curve, cross-process): use Image/Adjustments/Curves
editable work: use Layer/New Adjustment Layer/Levels

params.name: Adjustment
params.does: the input black / gamma / white and output black / white values for the composite or a channel; declared as an object (/levelsAdjustment) whose member keys the harvest did not read
params.typical: input black 10-30, white 225-245, gamma 0.8-1.2

params.name: Auto
params.does: true = Image/Auto Tone (ps_menu harvest: this event with auto, run live)
params.typical: true for a one-click fix

params.name: Auto Contrast
params.does: true = Image/Auto Contrast (ps_menu harvest: run live): contrast stretch on the composite, keeps the colour balance
params.typical: true when the colours are fine but the image is flat

params.name: Auto Black & White
params.does: automatic per-channel black and white points; with Auto Neutrals it is Image/Auto Color (ps_menu harvest: run live)
params.typical: true together with Auto Neutrals

params.name: Auto Neutrals
params.does: snaps midtones toward neutral grey to remove a cast
params.typical: true together with Auto Black & White

params.name: Using
params.does: loads a saved Levels preset file (.alv, e.g. Presets/Levels/Increase Contrast 2.alv)
params.typical: Increase Contrast 1-3, Lighten Shadows, Midtones Brighter

pairs_with: Image/Adjustments/Curves (finer tone shaping after Levels)
Layer/New Adjustment Layer/Levels (editable, maskable)
cards.scripting: var d = new ActionDescriptor(); d.putBoolean(stringIDToTypeID('autoBlackWhite'), true); d.putBoolean(stringIDToTypeID('autoNeutrals'), true); executeAction(stringIDToTypeID('levels'), d, DialogModes.NO);  // = Image/Auto Color (run live in the ps_menu harvest). Manual values: the 'adjustment' key (declared /levelsAdjustment, member keys not harvested) or, instead, a factory preset: d.putPath(stringIDToTypeID('using'), new File(app.path + '/Presets/Levels/Increase Contrast 2.alv')) (not run-tested)
cards.non_destructive: no: destructive (harvest); the editable form is Layer/New Adjustment Layer/Levels
cards.demo_note: Auto Color (Auto Black & White + Auto Neutrals, the descriptor the ps_menu harvest ran live for Image/Auto Color): the plate's bottom strip already spans black to white, so expect a modest contrast / cast change on the photo.

review.changes: summary / params: Auto, Auto Contrast and Auto Black & White + Auto Neutrals now cite the ps_menu harvest, which ran Image/Auto Tone, Auto Contrast and Auto Color live as this event (the card said 'not probed'); Adjustment described as the harvested object type (/levelsAdjustment), not an ActionList; gallery-limit note moved from avoid to demo_note

verified.note: Barely changed (mean diff 3.3): Auto Black & White + Auto Neutrals cool the neutrals a little (white type 255 to 243/250/255, the light ramp end to 235/241/250) and slightly mute the warm photo; the plate already spans 0-255, so the auto stretch has almost nothing to do. No stronger demo exists inside the harvest (the point values are in the unharvested Adjustment object), so demo_settings stay and rerender is false.

second_opinion.note: Plate check: the photo plate already has true black (type band) and near-white (ramp end), so auto black / white points cannot stretch it; the small cool shift is Auto Neutrals working as intended, so the frame does show the effect, weakly. Not a harness fault (index: nothing dropped). A visible Levels demo needs explicit points, which the harvest does not have.

cards.name: Match Color
cards.summary: Matches the target layer's colour and brightness statistics to a Source (another open image or layer, optionally only a selection in either) so shots from different sources look like one set. With no source it is a quick corrector: Luminance brightens or darkens, Color Range (the dialog's Color Intensity) raises or lowers colour intensity, Neutralize Color removes a cast and Fade blends back to the original. On the photo plate, Luminance 140 with Color Intensity 200 brightens the frame and pushes colourful areas further (the tan wall turns redder) while near-greys hardly change, and the already saturated blue and violet blocks clip and swing to magenta.
use_for: making photos from different cameras or events look like one set in a layout
matching a composited cut-out to its background plate
a quick cast fix (Neutralize) plus saturation boost without a reference
avoid: CMYK or Lab documents: Match Color works in RGB mode only
precise grading: it is statistical and can overshoot; use Curves or Color Balance adjustment layers
editable work: no adjustment-layer form; apply to a duplicate layer
scripted matching to a reference: Source is an object reference (another document or layer) whose structure the harvest did not read
Color Intensity near its maximum is not a clean saturation boost: saturated blues and violets clip and swing to magenta, so keep it well below 200 and check the blues

params.name: Luminance
params.does: brightness of the result, 100 = unchanged (harvested 0-200)

params.name: Color Range
params.does: colour intensity, 100 = unchanged, 0 = greyscale, higher = more saturated (harvested 0-200)

params.name: Fade
params.does: blends the result back toward the original (harvested 0-100)

params.name: Neutralize Color
params.does: removes a colour cast from the target
params.typical: on for casty indoor shots

params.name: No Reference Image
params.does: true = no Source, only the sliders apply (the default)
params.typical: false when matching to a Source

params.name: Source
params.does: the reference image / layer to match
params.typical: another open document

params.name: Use Source Selection
params.does: compute the reference colours from the source's selection only
params.typical: on when only part of the reference is relevant

params.name: Use Target Selection
params.does: compute the target statistics from the target's selection
params.typical: on to match a subject, not the whole frame

pairs_with: a selection in source and target (matches the subject, not the background)
Image/Adjustments/Curves (final tone touch after matching)
cards.scripting: var d = new ActionDescriptor(); d.putInteger(stringIDToTypeID('lightness'), 140); d.putInteger(stringIDToTypeID('colorRange'), 200); d.putInteger(stringIDToTypeID('fade'), 0); d.putBoolean(stringIDToTypeID('noReference'), true); executeAction(stringIDToTypeID('matchColor'), d, DialogModes.NO);  // to match a reference: noReference false + stringIDToTypeID('source') (/referenceOrFile, structure not harvested)

verified.note: Brighter (photo mean 138/108/70 to 153/117/74) with colourful areas pushed further (chroma of colourful pixels +15-30 %, the tan wall redder) while near-greys lose a little colour, and the saturated blue and violet blocks clip and swing to magenta (30/63/255 and 122/43/217 to 255/0/255): Color Intensity at 200 is not a plain saturation boost. Summary and avoid now say so.

second_opinion.note: Re-sampled: blue block 30/63/255 and violet block 122/43/217 are both 255/0/255 in the frame, sky-blue 0/163/224 is 125/131/255, colourful pixels gain chroma while near-greys lose a little; not a plate artefact (the blocks are flat colours) and not the harness (control matched dialogs). The rewritten sentence and the new avoid line state only this.

cards.name: OpenColorIO Transform
cards.summary: Appears to convert the layer's pixel values from one OpenColorIO colour space to another (for example a scene-linear working space to a display / view transform) using the document's OCIO configuration. The menu item was hidden in this harvest (the harvest notes the OCIO adjustment items appear only with an OCIO document open) and its options were not harvested, so the exact controls are unconfirmed.
use_for: VFX or 3D renders in ACES / scene-linear colour that need a display-space version
keeping a Photoshop paint-over in step with a compositing pipeline's OCIO colour spaces
avoid: ordinary sRGB / CMYK design work: use Edit/Convert to Profile (ICC) instead
scripts: no Action Manager event was found (harvest error); the adjustment-layer form only names an unverified candidate event adjustmentLayerOCIOAdjustment
pairs_with: Layer/New Adjustment Layer/OpenColorIO Transform (editable form, also hidden)
File/New OpenColorIO, File/Open as OpenColorIO or Edit/Convert to OpenColorIO (make the OCIO document first; all hidden or disabled in the harvest's scratch states)
Edit/OpenColorIO Settings
cards.scripting: No Action Manager event in Photoshop.exe's terminology (harvest error). Menu route only, when an OCIO document is open: UXP core.performMenuCommand({commandID: 3099}) (menuBarInfo id, not run-tested); it opens the dialog.
cards.non_destructive: no: the Image > Adjustments form is destructive (harvest)

review.changes: pairs_with: replaced the unsupported '32-bit documents' with the harvested OCIO document commands; summary: the 'only with an OCIO document' condition attributed to the harvest note

verified.note: Untested: status hidden (needs an OCIO-managed document; options not harvested), so it was not rendered.

second_opinion.note: No frame on disk and the id is listed in not_rendered.json / failed.json; the reason given matches the card status and the harvest.

cards.name: Photo Filter
cards.summary: Tints the image as if shot through a coloured lens filter: all tones are pushed toward the Filter Color by Density, and Preserve Luminosity keeps the brightness so the image does not darken. The default is an orange warming colour at density 25.
use_for: warming a cold photo (golden-hour feel) or cooling a warm one
unifying mixed photos in a collage under one shared colour cast
a strong single-colour wash behind type on a mood poster or thumbnail
avoid: a full monotone: use Hue/Saturation Colorize or Image/Adjustments/Gradient Map
editable work: use Layer/New Adjustment Layer/Photo Filter
Density above 100: the harvest probe stored any number unclamped (1e6 and -1e6 kept as sent) and the result past 100% was not tested; keep it a percentage at or below 100

params.name: Filter Color
params.does: the filter's colour (stored as Lab; default orange, Lab 67.06 / 32 / 120, which shows as #EC8A00 in sRGB)
params.typical: orange #EC8A00 to warm, blue #006DFF to cool

params.name: Density
params.does: strength of the tint in percent (default 25)
params.typical: 20-40 subtle, 60-90 strong wash

params.name: Preserve Luminosity
params.does: on keeps the original brightness; off darkens like a real glass filter
params.typical: on (the default)

pairs_with: Layer/New Adjustment Layer/Photo Filter with a mask (warm only the subject)
Image/Adjustments/Levels (restore contrast after a heavy filter)
cards.scripting: var d = new ActionDescriptor(); var c = new ActionDescriptor(); c.putDouble(stringIDToTypeID('luminance'), 67.06); c.putDouble(stringIDToTypeID('a'), 32); c.putDouble(stringIDToTypeID('b'), 120); d.putObject(stringIDToTypeID('color'), stringIDToTypeID('labColor'), c); d.putInteger(stringIDToTypeID('density'), 80); d.putBoolean(stringIDToTypeID('preserveLuminosity'), true); executeAction(stringIDToTypeID('photoFilter'), d, DialogModes.NO);  // Lab 67.06 / 32 / 120 is the harvested default and shows as #EC8A00 (the demo colour) in sRGB; for another hex use Photoshop's D50 Lab, e.g. #006DFF = 48.3 / 19.8 / -81.1
cards.non_destructive: no: destructive (harvest); the editable form is Layer/New Adjustment Layer/Photo Filter

review.changes: avoid: no longer states an unharvested 1-100 dialog range; Filter Color / scripting: the harvested default Lab displays as #EC8A00, so the scripting call and the demo agree; D50 Lab example for other colours

verified.note: Orange #EC8A00 at density 80 gives a strong warm cast (the cyan block turns grey, blue to violet) with brightness kept, as described.

cards.name: Posterize
cards.summary: Cuts each colour channel down to the given number of tone levels, so smooth gradients and skin break into flat, hard-edged bands of colour: a screen-print / pop-art poster look. Levels counts per channel, so 4 allows up to 64 colours in RGB.
use_for: pop-art or screen-print style posters and thumbnails
flattening a photo into a few colour areas before tracing it to vectors
a retro limited-palette comic or game look
avoid: high Levels values (above about 16) on soft images: the change is barely visible; use 2-8 for a clear look
a limited palette with chosen colours: use Image/Adjustments/Gradient Map or Indexed Color
noisy photos turn speckled: smooth first with Filter/Blur/Surface Blur
editable work: use Layer/New Adjustment Layer/Posterize

params.name: Levels
params.does: tone levels per channel (harvested 2-255, default 4)
params.typical: 3-6 strong, 8-12 subtle

pairs_with: Filter/Blur/Surface Blur (cleaner bands)
Image/Adjustments/Gradient Map (recolour the bands)
Filter/Pixelate/Color Halftone (print-dot finish on the flat bands)
cards.scripting: var d = new ActionDescriptor(); d.putInteger(stringIDToTypeID('levels'), 4); executeAction(stringIDToTypeID('posterization'), d, DialogModes.NO);
cards.non_destructive: no: destructive (harvest); the editable form is Layer/New Adjustment Layer/Posterize

verified.note: Four levels per channel: flat colour bands and a four-step ramp, as described.

cards.name: Replace Color
cards.summary: Selects pixels by colour (eyedropper samples define a colour range, widened by Fuzziness, or Localized Color Clusters) and shifts only that range's Hue, Saturation and Lightness, e.g. turning a red stripe teal while the rest stays put. It needs the sampled colour range: the harvest's call with an empty descriptor failed ('parameters not currently valid').
use_for: recolouring one coloured object (shirt, car, logo patch) to show colour variants
quick product colourway mock-ups
toning down a distracting coloured element in a photo
avoid: a colour that also appears elsewhere (red top next to skin): every matching pixel shifts; select the object first or mask a Hue/Saturation adjustment layer
editable work: no adjustment-layer form; work on a duplicate layer
headless calls without a colour range: executeAction failed in the harvest; the full descriptor (Minimum / Maximum colours plus shifts) was not run-tested
big hue shifts on low-saturation colours look grey and muddy; raise Saturation too

params.name: Fuzziness
params.does: how far around the sampled colours the selection spreads

params.name: Minimum
params.does: low corner of the sampled colour range
params.typical: darkest sample of the target colour

params.name: Maximum
params.does: high corner of the sampled colour range
params.typical: lightest sample of the target colour

params.name: Hue
params.does: hue shift applied to the selected colours

params.name: Saturation
params.does: saturation change for the selected colours

params.name: Lightness
params.does: lightness change for the selected colours

params.name: Foreground Color Clusters
params.does: Localized Color Clusters data for the sampled colours
params.typical: left to the dialog

pairs_with: a selection around the object (limits the swap)
Image/Adjustments/Hue/Saturation
cards.scripting: var d = new ActionDescriptor(); d.putInteger(stringIDToTypeID('fuzziness'), 80); /* d.putObject(stringIDToTypeID('minimum'), <colour class>, c1); d.putObject(stringIDToTypeID('maximum'), <colour class>, c2): declared /color, class not harvested; if Lab (D50): #9A1428 = 33.6 / 53.1 / 27.3, #FF2020 = 55.5 / 78.0 / 60.3, which brackets the plate's red block #E8202A = 50.8 / 72.2 / 49.6 */ d.putInteger(stringIDToTypeID('hue'), 160); d.putInteger(stringIDToTypeID('saturation'), 0); d.putInteger(stringIDToTypeID('lightness'), 0); executeAction(stringIDToTypeID('replaceColor'), d, DialogModes.NO);  // not run-tested; the empty call failed

review.changes: scripting: D50 Lab of the demo Minimum / Maximum, checked to bracket the plate's red block

verified.note: Untested: status needs_input (the harvest's call failed without a sampled colour range), so the gallery skipped it.

second_opinion.note: No frame on disk and the id is listed in not_rendered.json / failed.json; the reason given matches the card status and the harvest.

cards.name: Selective Color
cards.summary: Adds or removes cyan, magenta, yellow and black inside one colour family at a time (Reds, Yellows, Greens, Cyans, Blues, Magentas, Whites, Neutrals, Blacks), e.g. making greens more yellow or deepening blacks without touching other colours. Method picks Relative (scaled by the ink already there) or Absolute (a fixed amount).
use_for: film-look grades (teal shadows via Blacks, warm highlights via Whites)
fixing one off colour (greenish skin, cyan-heavy sky) in print-bound photos
nudging a brand colour in a product shot without a mask
avoid: large hue swaps: use Hue/Saturation or Replace Color
editable work: use Layer/New Adjustment Layer/Selective Color

Reds is a wide family: Reds cyan +50 also pulled red out of the orange (255 -> 196), yellow (255 -> 233) and pink-magenta (224 -> 167) bars in the gallery frame; mask it, or balance with Yellows / Magentas
read-backs name the Reds family 'radius' (a shared type id); send 'reds'

params.name: Color Correction
params.does: the per-colour-family ink amounts, an ActionList with one colorCorrection per family: colors (reds, yellows, greens, cyans, blues, magentas, whites, neutrals, blacks), cyan, magenta, yellowColor, black
params.typical: +/-10 to 40 per ink in one or two families

params.name: Method
params.does: relative scales the change by the ink already present; absolute adds a fixed amount (stronger)
params.typical: relative for subtle fixes, absolute for bold grades

params.name: Using
params.does: loads a saved Selective Color preset file
params.typical: a user-saved preset; the PS preset harvest has no factory Selective Color presets (no Presets/Selective Color folder)

pairs_with: Layer/New Adjustment Layer/Selective Color
Image/Adjustments/Curves
cards.scripting: var s=stringIDToTypeID, a=new ActionDescriptor(); a.putEnumerated(s('presetKind'), s('presetKindType'), s('presetKindCustom')); a.putEnumerated(s('method'), s('correctionMethod'), s('absolute')); var cc=new ActionDescriptor(); cc.putEnumerated(s('colors'), s('colors'), s('reds')); cc.putInteger(s('cyan'), 50); cc.putInteger(s('magenta'), 0); cc.putInteger(s('yellowColor'), 0); cc.putInteger(s('black'), 0); var lst=new ActionList(); lst.putObject(s('colorCorrection'), cc); a.putList(s('colorCorrection'), lst); executeAction(s('selectiveColor'), a, DialogModes.NO); /* the structure the gallery rendered */
cards.non_destructive: no: destructive (harvest); the editable form is Layer/New Adjustment Layer/Selective Color

review.changes: enum_labels for method set to the harvested labels (relative / absolute); Using: no factory Selective Color presets are installed; gallery-limit note moved from avoid to demo_note; demo still shows nothing (Color Correction not settable)

verified.note: Reds cyan +50 (absolute) acts only on red-family colours: the red bar drops 232 -> 137 in red alone (orange, yellow and pink bars lose red too), green / cyan / blue / violet bars and the grey ramp are untouched (difference 0.0), red stripes and the dark-red panel darken (red -30 on red pixels): selective, as described. Same pixels as the adjustment-layer frame (difference 0.0).
